ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 92% of the visible area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated solely on the perimeter and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a contiguous high-intensity white pixel mass. Low-intensity black pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips (left and right margins) and along the continuous trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a symmetrical vertex; estimated internal angle of 45 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the length of the trailing edge. A distinct high-amplitude notch/indentation is present on the outer third of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the median notch transitioning to convex towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast dark pixels on white background localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicative of localized scarring or colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy dark-toned pigmentation and irregular trailing edge morphology on the far left distal tip, suggesting previous physical trauma or erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: Pink/reddish pixel discoloration localized at the lower central insertion point where the fluke meets the water surface.
